About this pack:

This is a curated PvP Remix Pack specially edited for my 100-subscriber milestone. I’ve hand-picked the best textures from the community and combined them with my own custom adjustments to create the ultimate combat experience!

Credit to the original creators for the base textures.
Highlights:

🔥 **Low Fire** – Better visibility during intense fights, no more fire blocking your view!

🛡️ **Mini Side Shield** – Sleek, compact shield design for a wider field of vision.

⚔️ **Straight Sword** – Clean and aggressive sword model, perfect for combo hits.

🌌 **Custom Epic Sky** – Stunning, immersive sky textures that level up your game.
